notes.title: 🌍 Ongoing Content Updates – Region by Region!
notes.content:
[b]Conservation Concentration[/b] is just getting started! We're committed to expanding the game over the coming months with exciting new content released region by region. Each update will introduce:

🌿 New regions to explore

🐾 New animal species to discover and match

🕒 Fresh time challenges to test your memory and speed

🎯 Unique collectibles tied to each region

Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore completionist, there's always something new to uncover. Stay tuned and keep playing — your conservation journey is only just beginning!
